integrity: All 96 published facets are embedded. Integral H1 is reconstructed by tracked unimodular reduction, all 225 nonfacial triangles are exhaustively evaluated in the exact quotient lattice, primitivity and the seven-class spectrum are checked, and the order-three symmetry is verified on the full facet set.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to simple edge cycles in the published fifteen-vertex labelled triangulation. The symmetry-adapted integral basis is explicit rather than topologically canonical, and longer cycles or alternate triangulations are not classified.
title: Seven primitive homology directions exhaust the triangular systoles of Bagchi--Datta's fifteen-vertex tight \(4\)-manifold
